# AdaptiveDeepBrainStimulation

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A closed-loop neuromodulation technique that dynamically adjusts stimulation parameters based on neural state feedback, rather than using fixed, open-loop settings. Bridges neuromorphic computing with clinical neural interfaces, requiring real-time, low-latency, and energy-efficient processing that TCC topologies can provide.
